definition_short: fully-automated recursive self-improvement: EITHER a superhuman research/scientist agent OR an o1->o3-class generational gain in 1/5 the 2024 wall-clock time, sustained several months
status_note: framework definition dated 15 Apr 2025 (v2, still operative Jul 2026); status re-confirmed by the GPT-5.6 System Card (9 Jul 2026): no model at High or Critical self-improvement. If reached, safeguards required DURING development, not just deployment
source: OpenAI Preparedness Framework v2; GPT-5.6 System Card (9 Jul 2026)

definition_short: impact equivalent to giving every OpenAI researcher a performant mid-career research-engineer assistant vs their 2024 baseline
status_note: GPT-5.6 System Card (9 Jul 2026): the GPT-5.6 family is High in cyber and bio/chem but NOT High in self-improvement
source: OpenAI Preparedness Framework v2; GPT-5.6 System Card (9 Jul 2026)

definition_short: models can fully substitute for Anthropic's ENTIRE set of Research Scientists and Research Engineers at competitive cost (within a factor of 5); revised UP from the old RSP v2.2 'AI R&D-4' entry-level-researcher bar (which Anthropic notes several past models would already meet)
status_note: Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card (Jun 2026): NOT applicable to Mythos 5, re-evaluated DIRECTLY (Mythos 5 advances the frontier, so not a bound inherited from Opus 4.7/4.8); it 'does not seem close', especially vs senior researchers (concrete shortcomings, sec 2.3.3)
source: Anthropic RSP; Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card

definition_short: dramatic acceleration of the pace of AI progress attributable to the automation of AI R&D
status_note: Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card (Jun 2026): NOT met on three lines - ECI on-trend (same-size jump as Mythos Preview, constant rate not accelerating); internal UNPUBLISHED measures show no sustained AI-attributable 2x acceleration; automated evals are 'past the thresholds for definitively ruling out' dramatic acceleration but still indicate on-trend progress
source: Anthropic RSP; Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5 System Card

definition_short: a Gemini-powered evolutionary coding agent optimised a matrix-multiplication kernel used to TRAIN Gemini: 23% kernel speedup -> ~1% end-to-end Gemini training-time saving; deployed in Google datacentres
status_note: the recursion loop is real but the magnitude is small and bounded (1% is not foom, and it is a human-run tool, not an autonomous agent); scope widened through 2026 (datacentre scheduling, chip design, mathematics)
source: Google DeepMind AlphaEvolve blog; Novikov quote

trigger_name: Third-party assessment of internal AI use
definition_short: entity-based (not model-specific) pilot assessing misalignment risks from AI agents used INSIDE frontier developers; participants gave access to their most capable internal models, raw chains of thought, and non-public information on internal AI use and pace of progress
status_note: participants were Anthropic, Google, Meta and OpenAI; information gathering late Feb to mid Mar 2026, private reports early Mar to early Apr 2026. Reported finding: companies did NOT report evidence of dramatic speed-ups in overall pace of progress attributable to AI R&D automation, and Anthropic argued it had not seen a 2x increase as of Apr 2026. Separately assessed that internal agents plausibly had the means, motive and opportunity to start SMALL rogue deployments but not to make them highly resilient. METR tentatively plans to repeat in late 2026.
source: METR, Frontier Risk Report (February to March 2026), held and hashed
second_source: the four participating labs' own disclosures

definition_short: an AI system capable of fully autonomously designing and developing its own successor
status_note: Anthropic Institute, 'When AI builds itself': states 'We are not there yet, and recursive self-improvement is not inevitable. But it could come sooner than most institutions are prepared for.' Paired with a policy ask for the option to slow or temporarily pause frontier development. Same document reports >80% of merged code credited to Claude as of May 2026.
source: Anthropic Institute, 'When AI builds itself', held and hashed

trigger_name: Model instrumental in its own creation
definition_short: a released model used by its own team to debug its training, manage its deployment and diagnose evaluations
status_note: OpenAI, 'Introducing GPT-5.3-Codex' (2026-02-05): 'our first model that was instrumental in creating itself'. Named uses include monitoring and debugging the training run, adapting the harness and scaling GPU clusters at launch. NOT a red-line crossing: the same document classifies the model High capability for CYBERSECURITY under the Preparedness Framework and makes no self-improvement classification. The words 'self-improvement' and 'recursive' appear zero times in it.
second_source: TIME, 'Inside the Race to Make AI Build Itself' (Amelia Glaese, OpenAI VP of research)

definition_short: would require frontier developers to submit periodic confidential reports to the Department of Commerce summarising assessments of catastrophic risks arising from INTERNAL use of frontier models, and to report critical safety incidents within 72 hours including whether an incident was associated with internal use
status_note: introduced July 2026; a bill, not law. Recorded because it would convert the internal-use disclosure that METR piloted voluntarily into a reporting duty. Status only: no prediction of passage.

definition_short: AI writing 90% of code within three to six months of March 2025, and essentially all code within twelve months
status_note: Predicted 2025-03-10 at CFR. Both horizons have passed: the 90% window closed by Sep 2025, the 'essentially all' window by Mar 2026. Checkable against the same company's own later measurement: the Anthropic Institute reported >80% of MERGED code credited to Claude as of May 2026. Scopes are not identical and the comparison is indicative, not a scoring of the prediction. The primary also carries the qualifier secondary reporting drops: the programmer still specifies conditions, the overall app and design decisions.
source: CFR full transcript, held and hashed
second_source: Anthropic Institute, 'When AI builds itself', held and hashed

definition_short: asked for an over-under on the year of AGI, answers 2030 and says he has been consistent about that
status_note: Stated 2026-04-20 at Sequoia AI Ascent, rapid-fire section. No definition of AGI is given in the exchange, and no test is stated by which arrival would be recognised. Horizon has not elapsed. Recorded descriptively.
source: Local Whisper transcript, held and hashed

definition_short: an intern-level research assistant by September 2026 and a fully automated AI researcher by March 2028
status_note: Reported by TIME 2026-08-07, attributed to OpenAI executives; traced to an October 2025 livestream. The September 2026 leg falls due within weeks of this version. No definition of 'automated AI researcher' is recorded, and no acceptance test is stated.
